title: 14:12 fallen from heaven/cut down to the ground. The first phrase implies that Lucifer was a star that lost its heavenly prominence by falling (Rev. 8:10; 9:1; 2 Ne. 2:17). The second phrase suggests that Lucifer was a mighty tree that was cut down by God the forester (10:33-34). Both the star and the tree commonly symbolize an individual, and both show how Lucifer was once mighty.
author: Tina M. Peterson
